sections.content: mikor? asks 'when?'. To answer with a month, add -ban or -ben, chosen by vowel harmony: áprilisban means 'in April'. Because január, február, március and április are all back-vowel words, all four take -ban.
Once you can hear a word as back- or front-vowel, -ban/-ben stops being a memorized exception list and becomes something you can predict for any new month or noun you meet.
